## Scenario
Darla is nervous about presenting her work to a group of seniors who might not understand it, as they don't know much about her area.

## Question 
In this scenario, what is the most effective Action for Darla?

## Choices
A) Organize a pre-presentation session to familiarize the seniors with her area of work
B) Ask for someone more knowledgeable in her area to present her work instead
C) Work on her presentation, simplifying the explanations
D) Practice her presentation by speaking with people knowledgeable about her research
